5_step_chain_validated: 1. Service mutation in DB::transaction { ... } commits the aggregate
2. DispatchableAfterCommit trait fires event AFTER commit (drops on rollback)
3. PersistTo*Outbox listener writes domain_events row with idempotency_key + channel + broadcast_as + correlation_id. wasRecentlyCreated guard prevents replay duplication.

4. DB::afterCommit closure dispatches DispatchDomainEventsJob (atomic claim via lockForUpdate + dispatched_at sentinel; broadcast outside transaction; Cache::put('ws:heartbeat', now, 120s) on success).
5. Frontend Echo subscriber on private-branch.{id} fires .{broadcastAs} handler; correlation_id dedupe (2048-cap) drops replays; UI updates DOM.
